page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; below it a heading line with the emblem title and number at right; then a woodcut illustration of a man at a table with dishes; below the woodcut a four-line verse with a large initial Q, and at lower right the word "Dolium" in larger type.

main_text.l: Homo ad mensam edens & bibens. XI.

l.i: Et nos à Christi quod sitam morte petamus,

page.notes: The large initial Q is a woodcut-style initial, joined to the first word as "Quicquid" in the printed line. The woodcut shows a man seated at a table with fish, a roast bird and a dish, a goblet, and windows behind. The word "Dolium" at lower right is set in larger type and is treated here as a signature-like element below the verse. The line "Philosophe rides impie_?" has a printed mark after "impie" which is read as a dash-stroke ending and may be a printing error.
